title: fix(fields): the date-time picker's popover picks the hour and minute
body:
Fixes #32589

Clause-②: yes (widening: fields.datePicker.time, fields.datePicker.hour, fields.datePicker.minute)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录表单上 `datetime` 字段的日期选择弹层,在日历下方加了「小时 + 分钟」两个下拉,用户点选即可设定时间,不必再手打整串日期时间。`date` 字段不变。
- 为什么改:原弹层只有日历和「今天/明天」,选日期只会写入 00:00(或保留旧时间),请假、会议这类表单的用户以为「选不了时间」。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `@object-ui/fields` 的日期选择器与 11 个语言包各 3 个新键;写入值的格式与换算不变(仍是本地时钟转 ISO)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/date-picker/DatePickerField.tsx`(`pickDay` 与新的时间行);`localeDateText.ts`(小时标签、分钟选项);`DatePickerField-12622.test.tsx` 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/date-picker/`,预期 2 个文件、35 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The `datetime` face of the platform picker (`DateTimePickerField`, which is `TemporalPicker` with `withTime`) gets an hour and a minute control under the calendar in its popover. Both are the generic `Select` primitive from `@object-ui/components`; no new widget.

- **Hours** are labelled with the display locale's own two-digit hour (`localeHourLabel`), on the same clock the text box shows: `06 PM` in `en`, `18时` in `zh`, `18 Uhr` in `de`.
- **Minute step: fixed at 5.** No field key declares a time step for `datetime`: the only `step` in the field schema is described as the slider's increment and ledgered renderer-live for the slider alone, so reading it here would give an existing key a new meaning (a metadata-protocol change this card does not carry). No new key is invented. A value's own minute off the grid (`09:17`) is still offered and kept (`minuteOptions`), so nothing stored is rounded.
- **Empty value: the time control is focused next.** On the `datetime` face a day pick (calendar or Today / Tomorrow) no longer closes the popover: it writes the day, keeps the popover open and moves focus to the hour control. With an empty value the day is written at `00:00`, the same reading a typed date with no time already gets in `parseLocaleDateText`, and the hour control showing `12 AM` is where focus lands, so midnight is never committed out of sight. Chosen over a default time because any default (next hour, 09:00) is a business guess this widget cannot know; the focus-next route keeps the existing reading and puts the decision in front of the user. Picking a time before any day writes it on today.
- **Picking a day keeps the value's time**, as before.
- **Timezone: unchanged.** Every pick builds the native local wall clock `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` and writes it through `fromDateTimeInputValue`, the same write the text box uses; the controls read back through `toDateTimeInputValue`. A pin shows a picked time reads back as the time picked.
- **The `date` face is unchanged**: no time row, and a day pick still closes the popover (CONTROL pin).
- **Strings:** `fields.datePicker.time`, `fields.datePicker.hour`, `fields.datePicker.minute` in all eleven packs. The provider-less fallback is the inline `defaultValue` at the call site, so `useFieldTranslation.ts` (outside the claimed file surface) is not touched.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/date-picker/DatePickerField-12622.test.tsx`: new top-level describe in the existing harness file, 8 pins: an hour pick writes that hour on the value day keeping the minute; a minute pick keeps the hour; round trip (written value reads back as `11/12/2026, 06:15 PM`, hour `06 PM`, minute `15`); off-grid minute shown; empty value + day pick writes `00:00`, keeps the popover open and focuses the hour; empty value + time pick writes today; zh session names the controls from the zh pack and labels hours `18时`; CONTROL: the `date` face has no time row and a day pick closes the popover.
- `localeDateText.test.ts`: hour labels in `en` / `zh` / `de`, minute grid with an off-grid value.
